name: reticence
quote: She doesn't talk much about herself.
description: A preference to avoid talking about your thoughts and feelings generally, or in a particular situation.
alternateDefinitions: 'Reticence' has started to overlap in usage with 'reluctant', which is a more general unwillingness to do something. The usage here is about communication.
perceptions: If I say something, it might come out sounding wrong.
I'd prefer not to talk on this topic right now.
examples: Not wanting to weigh in on an already heated conversation.

guidance.description: Holding back on communication due to concern about the situation may be wise. If reticence in general is causing you social problems, consider the guidance for 'timidness' or 'shyness'.

comparisons.description: If you're stressed about potential outcomes of a social interaction, 'reticence' is one of the possible results.
If there's an unwritten expectation that you'll participate in a conversation, then 'reticence' could be considered a specific form of 'defiance'.

commentaries.quote: Many times in life I've regretted the things I've said without thinking. But I've never regretted the things I said nearly as much as the words I left unspoken.
Among my most prized possessions are words that I have never spoken.
Never complain, never explain. Resist the temptation to defend yourself or make excuses.
Silence does not always mark wisdom.
I remember manners, that's when people are scared to make other persons mad.
